prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you need. Do you mean best for ad performance, AI-driven creative, personalization & CDP integration, analytics/modeling, or something else? Also useful to know: your budget, company size (startup vs. enterprise), industry, and timeline.

If you’d like, I can either make a tailored short list of top LA agencies that match your needs or give a general shortlist plus a vetting checklist. To help decide, here are quick, practical next steps and what I’ll need from you to recommend the best fit:

Questions I need
- What outcome matters most? (e.g., lower CPA, higher LTV, faster content production, personalization)
- Monthly/annual budget range (rough)
- Company size and team (do you have in-house marketers/data engineers?)
- Industry or regulatory constraints (healthcare, finance, etc.)
- Preferred scope: one-off project, ongoing retainer, or staff augmentation?

How I’ll evaluate agencies (the checklist I use)
- Proven case studies with measurable KPIs for similar clients
- Clear AI approach: ML models, data strategy, model retraining cadence, explainability
- Tech integrations: experience with your ad platforms, CDP, CRM, analytics stack
- Creative + data collaboration (can they produce AI-assisted creative, not just models?)
- Compliance & data security practices (especially if you handle PII)
- Team composition and seniority (data scientists, ML engineers, strategists, creatives)
- Pricing model transparency and expected ROI / timelines
- Client references and retention rate

Typical service specializations (pick one)
- Performance marketing + programmatic optimization
- Generative creative & automation (copy, images, video)
- Personalization & recommendations (site, email, in-app)
- Customer analytics & predictive LTV/churn modeling
- End-to-end MarTech implementation (CDP, orchestration, automation)

If you want, I can:
- Provide a tailored 3–5 agency shortlist in Los Angeles matched to your answers (I can include links, strengths, example case studies and how they’d approach your use case), or
- Give a general list of widely respected LA digital/AI marketing agencies and the scenarios they’re best for.

Which would you prefer? If tailored, please answer the short questions above and I’ll compile the shortlist.
